title: Quenched Crispy Fried Malaysian Tofu Satay
description: A classic Malaysian dish of crispy fried tofu served with a spicy peanut sauce. A perfect combination of crunchy and tangy flavors.
instructions: Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine coconut milk, peanut butter, brown sugar, chilli flakes, and tandoor spice mix. Blend until smooth.
In a shallow dish, mix together cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Dip each tofu cube into the cornstarch mixture, coating evenly.
Heat 1 inch of sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the tofu cubes in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the tofu from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a small saucepan, combine the peanut sauce mixture and soy sauce. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the rice vinegar and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the crispy fried tofu with the spicy peanut sauce and garnish with coriander leaves.
